title: Conditional Gaussian filtering by Arthurs--Kelly readout in a three-mode cluster wire
summary: Measurement readout programs the Gaussian operation implemented by a continuous-variable cluster wire. For the standard three-node wire, momentum homodyne readout gives an additive parity channel with finite-squeezing noise. We classify the pattern-resolved input--output covariance transformations generated by calibrated uncorrelated Arthurs--Kelly readout on one or both consumed nodes. Any finite Arthurs--Kelly position record produces a conditional Gaussian filter whose gain and residual covariance depend on the input covariance entries, rather than an input-independent additive Gaussian…
